propositions: Reconcile passes may mutate Jira with mapped projects that do not exist or are not visible to the bridge bot, only surfacing failures deep in fan-out as ACLI errors instead of failing at preflight
legacy_default projects are returned unvalidated by resolve_project and can drive mass CREATE storms into wrong or nonexistent projects because the cross-project write guard excludes creates

A preflight probe must enumerate bot-visible project keys via the Cloud REST endpoint GET /rest/api/3/project/search through AcliClient._direct_rest_get before any outbound mutation, validating required keys (mapped projects, legacy_default, and fallback query_project when projects is empty) are reachable

Preflight probes only run for Cloud backends (reconciler.backend='jira') and are skipped for other backends or clients lacking _direct_rest_get; transport errors and missing keys both fail closed with distinct error types and prevent reconcile_once from being called
Preflight failure must be converted to an OPERATIONAL_FAILURE PassResult with an actionable message naming offending keys, without raising uncaught exceptions that would crash run_pass
